comment: Website-local (not a desktop vector): §9 flow 8 handover, desktop→cloud. Seed a MIRROR scope (epoch 0) whose journal holds verbatim hub seqs 5,6,7 (exactly how mirror.ts stores a hub's rows) plus a STALE dataset_sync_seq=2 left over from an earlier authority period. Handing the scope TO authority must (a) bump the journal_epoch exactly once (INV-13) and (b) clear the stale counter so the next minted seq self-seeds ABOVE the mirror high-water — expect_seq 8, proving INV-1's continuous number space survives a re-handover (without the counter reset it would wrongly restart near 3, behind the hub's own seqs, and a follower at cursor 7 would be orphaned). A repeated same-role handover is idempotent: changed=false, the epoch stays 1 — INV-13 bumps only on a real change.
